meta.description: For property managers in Québec: Verikora reads the documents an applicant sends and your lease template, and ties every finding to its line and its article of law.

landing.title: Check the file before you offer the unit.
landing.lead: For property managers in Québec. Verikora reads the documents an applicant sends and your lease template, and ties every finding to its line and its article of law.

status.label: Status
status.development: In development: sign-up is closed while we test it on real Québec leases.
status.preview: Dev preview: sign-up is closed, access by invitation.

hero.primary: Write to us to try it on your files
hero.findingCaption: What Verikora returns, with its source

what.title: What Verikora checks
what.lead: Three things, in the order of your work.

documents.title: The applicant's documents
documents.text: Pay stub, bank statement, ID: each document is read, and the PDF is examined as a file (producer, dates, successive saves). An edit is reported at three levels: observed, unusual, inconsistent.

template.title: Your lease template
template.text: Your lease is checked before you send it, against Québec's rules: each finding names the rule, quotes the Civil Code article and lights the sentence of the lease.

report.title: A report to share
report.text: A read-only page by link, with an expiry: the document's fingerprint, the findings with their articles and the run that produced them.

proof.title: One real check
proof.lead: A sample lease, checked in development and recorded as it came back. The rule, the line, the article of law, the run id and the date are the engine's answer, not typed by hand.
proof.figures: {rules} rules checked, {found} findings on this sample lease.

applicant.title: The applicant agrees first
applicant.lead: No check goes ahead without the applicant's agreement, check by check. They see the result first, before you do.
points: Each check asked for has its own consent.
The applicant sees the result before it is passed to you.
Verikora asks for neither a social insurance number nor a criminal history.
A finding the applicant disputes, they raise with the person who asked for their documents: Verikora does not decide on the unit.

closing.title: This week's files, checked.
closing.tenant: Asked for your documents through Verikora?

visual.caption: A real check, recorded as it came back

showcase.title: The app, as it is
showcase.lead: Three screens of Verikora, drawn with its own components on fictitious data. Nothing here is a screenshot.

findings.title: Every finding quotes its line
findings.text: The rule, the sentence of the lease it rests on, and the article of law, in the order to read them.
findings.summary: The report of a check: the verdict, then each finding with the quoted passage of the lease and its article.

screening.title: A screening the tenant agrees to
screening.text: The applicant sees the result first; a registry check that is not ready says so instead of guessing.
screening.summary: A screening result with the checks asked and, for each, its outcome: nothing to report, or not available yet.

owner.title: A report the owner can open
owner.text: A read-only page by link, with an expiry: the file's fingerprint, the findings and the run that produced them.
owner.summary: The owner's page: the document fingerprint, the findings with their articles, and the run id.

stage.title: Development version
stage.message: Data can be reset at any time. This is not a commercial offer yet.
